caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely about the speed you carry into a turn. It is about the trail that forms under your tires, shaped by the rain and the slope of the land. When the road narrows into the canopy, the only thing that matters is the rhythm of your own breathing and the soft crunch of gravel beneath you. There is no engine here, no crowd, and no schedule to keep. Just the quiet focus of moving through a landscape that doesn't care how fast you go, only that you’re present enough to see it.
